behaviors.behavior: The claim HOLDER (matching claimToken, within the launch window) can launch a claimed task
A stranger (foreign or absent claimToken) is refused with 409, even against a webui process that persisted nothing since the claim was written to disk
A restart (resume) by the holder succeeds, not just the initial launch
A claim older than the 24h window is refused even with the correct token, distinguishable from a foreign claim via claimExpired:true
baseline is refreshed alongside sessions so a subsequent persist() does not write a released/foreign claim back to disk

behaviors.behavior: No ELOCKED on the launch path under a concurrent persist() from the same process
A task with no claimToken at all still launches unconditionally
